business_problem: Eneco eMobility needed to help a growing customer care organization handle rising EV charging demand faster and at lower cost without sacrificing employee or customer experience.
solution_summary: Eneco eMobility extended its existing Microsoft customer-service stack with Microsoft Digital Contact Center and Copilot in Dynamics 365 for Customer Service to help agents handle a fast-growing EV charging customer base. Capgemini first reviewed operating processes and then built an iterative rollout that started with a small group of expert agents, allowing features to be tested and refined before wider deployment. The AI-assisted experience pulls CRM context into the agent workflow, surfaces relevant knowledge-base content, generates live conversation summaries, and produces handoff notes so the next team can continue a case without rework. The same Copilot capabilities support chat-based answers to hard questions and faster after-call completion. The program was ideated and piloted within five weeks, then expanded from Belgium into the Netherlands, giving Eneco a lower-cost, faster-training service model that improves both employee productivity and customer experience.
